scenario: LSIG.1.3.3 CC-6: `active_fraction tumbling` is a compile error — active_fraction is admitted only under the `sliding` time model.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    active: Bool mutable

series Sensor.active:
    active_fraction tumbling 5_min

rule r:
    Sensor
->
    log info "x"
